measures.name: m_paid_order_count
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_valid_order_count

measures.name: m_cancelled_order_count
measures.expr: case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_refund_order_count
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_partial_refund_order_count
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_full_refund_order_count
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_payment_cents
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end

measures.name: m_refund_cents
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end

measures.name: m_net_sales_cents
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end

measures.name: m_gross_cents
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end

measures.name: m_discount_cents
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end

measures.name: m_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end

measures.name: m_refund_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end

measures.name: m_selling_store_count_distinct
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end

measures.name: m_valid_order_items
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end

measures.name: m_first_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: case when order_rank = 1 then member_id end

measures.name: m_first_order_sales_cents
measures.expr: case when order_rank = 1 then net_sales_cents else 0 end

measures.name: m_first_order_count
measures.expr: case when order_rank = 1 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_repeat_order_count
measures.expr: case when order_rank >= 2 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: m_monthly_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: member_id

measures.name: m_monthly_repeat_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: case when order_count >= 2 then member_id end

measures.name: m_new_member_count_distinct
measures.expr: member_id

measures.name: m_monthly_paid_buyer_count
measures.expr: paid_buyer_count

measures.name: m_monthly_paid_order_count
measures.expr: paid_order_count

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。单位：单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。单位：单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。单位：单。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。单位：单。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。单位：单。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。单位：单。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。单位：单。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位：分。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位：分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位：分。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位：分。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位：分。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。单位：账户。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。单位：账户。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。单位：门店。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。单位：件。

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.label: 有效订单均额
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数；分母零时未定义。单位：分／单。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数；分母零时未定义。单位：分／账户。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.label: 购买频次
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数；分母零时未定义。单位：单／账户。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.label: 退款金额占比
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额；分母零时未定义。单位：比例。

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: 取消率
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数；分母零时未定义。单位：比例。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.label: 退款订单率
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数；分母零时未定义。单位：比例。

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.label: 优惠率
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母零时未定义。单位：比例。

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: 单均商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数；分母零时未定义。单位：件／单。

metrics.name: new_member_count
metrics.label: 注册会员数
metrics.description: 按注册日期统计新注册 CRM 账户数；可按归属门店和会员等级分组，不等于自然人数。单位：账户。

metrics.name: first_buyer_count
metrics.label: 观测期首购会员数
metrics.description: 在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 账户数；不代表终身首购。先用全覆盖历史确定首次，再按窗口筛选。单位：账户。

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents
metrics.label: 观测期首单净销售额
metrics.description: 每个账户在测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额，按该单日期归属；相同日期按订单号排序；单位：分。

metrics.name: first_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期首单数
metrics.description: 在全测试覆盖期内先为每个账户按日期、订单号排序，其第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数。单位：单。

metrics.name: repeat_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期后续购买订单数
metrics.description: 账户全测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单，按订单日期落入窗口计数；不是月内复购人数。单位：单。

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内购买会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；允许连续整月按月分别展示，不能跨月直接加总当人数。单位：账户。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内复购会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；不能由全量订单行上的简单条件代替。单位：账户。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月内复购率
metrics.description: 同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数，仅整月、全门店口径；分母零时未定义；跨多月查询必须按月展示。单位：比例。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员购买人数
metrics.description: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合总部运营月报付费资格的不同账户数；按P1暂定试算。单位：账户。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_order_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员有效订单数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的全部有效订单数，按账户资格筛选，不按卡重复；按P1暂定试算。单位：单。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents
metrics.label: 月末付费会员净销售额
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的有效订单净销售额合计；按P1暂定试算。单位：分。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购人数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格，且同一自然月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数；按P1暂定试算。单位：账户。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购率
metrics.description: 月末付费会员复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；分母为零时未定义；按P1暂定试算。单位：比例。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_avg_order_value
metrics.label: 月末付费会员订单均额
metrics.description: 月末付费会员净销售额除以月末付费会员有效订单数；分母零时未定义；按P1暂定试算。单位：分／单。

卡在生效当天开始有效，到计划到期日当天已经无效；有提前终止日期的，从提前终止当天起无效。提前终止日期为空，只说明这条记录没有提前终止，不代表有效期无限。
为完成本期合成测试库的六项工程实现，本轮显式暂定沿用陈姐的门店规则。

constraints: P1暂定试算；门店日期规则用于总部月报仍待书面确认；仅适用于通过日期前置检查的数据
仅支持完整自然月、全渠道、全门店，多月按月展示，暂不按门店或渠道拆分。

model_sql.orders_enriched: SELECT o.order_id, o.member_id, o.store_id, o.ordered_at, o.status, o.gross_cents, o.paid_cents, o.refund_cents, o.quantity, o.channel, m.home_store_id FROM {{ ref('orders') }} o LEFT JOIN {{ ref('members') }} m ON o.member_id = m.member_id
model_sql.valid_orders_sequenced: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT *, paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents FROM {{ ref('orders_enriched') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0), sequenced AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS order_rank FROM valid_orders) SELECT * FROM sequenced
model_sql.monthly_account_orders: WITH monthly AS (SELECT member_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM {{ ref('orders_enriched') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY member_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS DATE)) SELECT member_id, month_start, order_count, member_id || '|' || CAST(month_start AS VARCHAR) AS member_month_key FROM monthly
model_sql.monthly_paid_month: WITH months AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date_trunc('month', date_day) AS DATE) AS month_start FROM {{ ref('time_spine') }}), month_bounds AS (SELECT month_start, CAST(month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS DATE) AS month_end FROM months), valid_cards AS (SELECT card_id, member_id, card_type, valid_from, valid_until, ended_at FROM {{ ref('cards') }} WHERE card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡') AND valid_from IS NOT NULL AND valid_until IS NOT NULL AND valid_from < valid_until AND (ended_at IS NULL OR (ended_at > valid_from AND ended_at < valid_until))), eligible_account_months AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.month_start, c.member_id FROM month_bounds b JOIN valid_cards c ON c.valid_from <= b.month_end AND b.month_end < c.valid_until AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR b.month_end < c.ended_at)), month_orders AS (SELECT member_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_sales_cents FROM {{ ref('orders_enriched') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY member_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS DATE)), account_month AS (SELECT e.month_start, e.member_id, COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(o.net_sales_cents, 0) AS net_sales_cents FROM eligible_account_months e LEFT JOIN month_orders o ON e.member_id = o.member_id AND e.month_start = o.month_start), month_agg AS (SELECT month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_count >= 1 THEN member_id END) AS paid_buyer_count, SUM(order_count) AS paid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END) AS paid_repeat_buyer_count, SUM(net_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents FROM account_month GROUP BY month_start) SELECT m.month_start, CAST(m.month_start AS VARCHAR) AS month_key, COALESCE(a.paid_buyer_count, 0) AS paid_buyer_count, COALESCE(a.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count, COALESCE(a.paid_repeat_buyer_count, 0) AS paid_repeat_buyer_count, COALESCE(a.paid_sales_cents, 0) AS paid_sales_cents FROM months m LEFT JOIN month_agg a ON m.month_start = a.month_start
model_sql.card_date_exceptions: SELECT card_id, member_id, card_type, valid_from, valid_until, ended_at FROM {{ ref('cards') }} WHERE card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡') AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from >= valid_until OR (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT (ended_at > valid_from AND ended_at < valid_until)))
model_sql.store_dimension: SELECT store_id, region, store_name FROM {{ ref('stores') }}
model_sql.home_store_dimension: SELECT store_id, region, store_name FROM {{ ref('stores') }}

business_model_usage.quote: 有效订单、金额、月内购买与复购的定义及整月全范围限制继续按材料01至04和本模型第2节执行。零分母保持未定义。
先在全测试覆盖历史内，对有效订单按日期、订单号排序确定每个账户的第一笔，再按查询窗口筛选；不能理解为全部订单中的第一笔，也不代表终身首购
月内购买会员数为同月至少一笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数为同月至少两笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购率为后者除以前者，分母为零时未定义。适用限制：仅支持完整自然月、全门店；连续多月按月分别展示，不将每月去重人数相加为跨月人数
为完成本期合成测试库的六项工程实现，本轮显式暂定沿用陈姐的门店规则。
生效日期不晚于D，即 valid_from <= D。
D早于计划到期日期，即 D < valid_until。
提前终止日期为空，或D早于提前终止日期，即 ended_at为空或 D < ended_at。
材料04已明确先判断月末资格，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单。
按小林口径，本期总部运营月报的付费资格只纳入悦享年卡与家庭季卡；异业联名卡与体验卡不纳入
任一符合范围且判定日有效的卡即可形成账户资格，是陈姐说明的门店规则；多张有效卡不能把同一账户重复算人或重复累计订单
资格判断看卡类型与有效状态，不看会员等级，也不能用支付金额代替
成交门店与会员归属门店不同，见 05
